Probability.Counting & factorials: Combinatorics and the gamma function. n k COMB gives C(n,k).
Probability.Random numbers & simulation: RAND is uniform on (0,1). A random digit is RAND 10 * IP. RDZ seeds it so a simulation can be repeated.
Probability.Distributions: Only normal, chi-square, F and t are built in (as upper-tail UTP*). P(X<=x) = 1 - UTPN(...). Binomial, Poisson and exponential need a short program.
Probability.Sums, expectation & generating functions: Symbolic sums and integrals compute E[X], Var(X) and probability generating functions exactly.
Probability.Descriptive statistics: Put data in ΣDAT with Σ+ (or STOΣ), pick columns with XCOL/YCOL, then call these. VAR/SDEV are sample; PVAR/PSDEV are population.
Probability.Correlation & regression: Fit a model with LR (or BESTFIT/LINFIT/EXPFIT/LOGFIT/PWRFIT), then predict with PREDX/PREDY.
Probability.Plots: Histograms and scatterplots of the data in ΣDAT.
Probability.Markov chains & matrices: Transition matrices: powers with ^, stationary distribution from EGV/EGVL or by solving with LSQ / RREF.
Probability.Differential & Laplace tools: For birth-death processes, queues and the Kolmogorov equations in continuous time.
